privacy.title: Privacy policy for the online credential verification system
privacy.s1Body: Krirk University, through the Office of the Registrar, is the data controller for all personal data processed by this verification system. Requests for access, correction or erasure go to the Data Protection Officer listed alongside this policy.
privacy.s2Body: The system processes only what verification requires.
privacy.s2IdentifiersV: citizen ID or passport number of the person being verified, stored as an HMAC-SHA256 hash for searching and AES-256-GCM ciphertext for staff review
privacy.s2AcademicV: name, student code, education level, degree, programme, faculty, status, graduation and council approval dates, GPA and honours, synced from the registry system
privacy.s2RequesterV: organisation details, contact name, email, phone, plus IP address, user agent and consent timestamp for each request
privacy.s3Body: Data is processed to verify academic credentials at the request of an organisation with legitimate grounds, and to keep the access records the law requires. We do not use it for marketing and we do not sell or transfer it abroad.
privacy.s3Box: Requests are never processed without an explicit PDPA consent tick, recorded with its exact timestamp.
privacy.s4Body: Identifiers are hashed with a server-side pepper and encrypted at rest. Screens always show masked values; revealing a full number requires a staff role and writes an audit entry. Requests are rate limited per user and per IP, and results are only reachable with an individual access code.
privacy.s5Body: Verification requests are anonymised {requestYears} years after the decision. Audit log entries are retained for {auditYears} years to support external inspection. Result access codes expire {linkDays} days after approval; the result snapshot itself is retained for the request retention period.
privacy.s6Body: Data subjects may request access, correction, erasure, restriction or objection, and may withdraw consent at any time.
privacy.s6Box: Withdrawing consent does not invalidate results already issued, because those records must remain verifiable. It does stop any further processing.
privacy.s7Body: Office of the Registrar, Krirk University, 3 Soi Ram Inthra 1, Anusawari, Bang Khen, Bangkok 10220 · dpo@krirk.ac.th · 02-970-5820 ext. 201. Complaints may also be filed with the Personal Data Protection Committee.

terms.title: Terms of service for the online credential verification system
terms.t1Body: This system verifies the credentials of Krirk University graduates free of charge. Results are shown on the web with a reference number that can be re-checked. It does not issue certificates or transcripts in place of the university's official documents.
terms.t2Body: Users must provide accurate, current information. External organisations must be approved by registrar staff before submitting requests. Users must keep their passwords secret and are responsible for all activity under their account.
terms.t3Body: Submit requests only with legitimate grounds and the data subject's consent, for example when considering a job applicant. Do not use the system to guess or harvest personal data in bulk. Requests are rate limited per user and per IP, and the university may suspend accounts that misuse the service.
terms.t3Box: Every request and every result view is logged with the user, time and IP address for legally required inspection.
terms.t4Body: A result reflects the record at the moment of approval and can be opened via its link until the access code expires. “No matching record” does not mean the person did not graduate; the details provided may simply not match the registry.
terms.t5Body: The service is provided as available. The university is not liable for decisions based on identifiers entered incorrectly by the requester, or for use of results beyond the purpose stated in the request.
terms.t6Body: The university may update these terms from time to time; the version and update date are shown on this page. Questions go to the Office of the Registrar on 02-970-5820 or reg@krirk.ac.th.
